pre_registration.task: 47-b two-reader rule (first installment, mid-arc item 7): a crab-traps-side SECOND READER independently walks the SAME 8 chains the fleet's wave-46 witness rollout verified, compares computed tips/binding facts against the wave-46 receipted pins, emits a two-reader receipt whose rows carry walker identity 'crab-traps-second-reader', and exits 0 iff every chain agrees
pre_registration.registered_at_utc: mtime of this file is the binding receipt; recorded BEFORE any official second-reader run
pre_registration.walker_independence_law: the walker is WRITTEN FROM THE LAW, not ported from fleet code: row_hash = sha256(UTF8(canonicalJSON([prev, row-minus-row_hash]))); canonicalJSON = object keys sorted recursively by Unicode code unit, undefined-valued keys skipped, arrays keep order, JSON.stringify scalar semantics, no whitespace; stone row 0 must be kind 'stone.header' with alg 'stone-v1'; annotation rows (kind 'stone.*' except 'stone.header') never advance the tip; witness receipts carry exactly {claim, inputs_sha256, output_sha256, parent, ts}, id = sha256(canonical json), first parent = 'GENESIS', tip = id(last receipt). Fleet modules tools/lib/stone-v1.mjs and playtest/wave44/witness-grammar/witness.mjs were READ AS SPEC ONLY; no fleet walker code copied; no shared code with fleet-seeds
pre_registration.pin_provenance: every pin below is reused verbatim from the fleet's wave-46 rollout receipts: playtest/wave46/witness-rollout/walkers.mjs PINS + receipts/run-receipt.json targets + claims.json (claims sha cfaf425b42ac2824b91c9190a0d89d34be9158657815399e12e0513d4ca0118a) + committed fetched bytes under receipts/fetched/, all read at fleet-seeds commit 9c46c34253c18ae3f94f764470ccb6e837768255
pre_registration.recon_disclosure: pre-registration reconnaissance, disclosed: (a) 5 raw.githubusercontent GETs at the pinned URLs returned bytes whose sha256 match the receipted pins (6637ce7d…, 3340b082…, 6e958f67…, 818e6683…, 6d7db23e…); (b) a throwaway canonicalJSON written fresh from the law reproduced the fleet walker's receipted output digests for the three non-chain targets (crabtraps_45c 9267feb4…, crabtraps_44a 5e7d51ca…, fleetseeds_fixtures 108f535f…) — this probe informed the digest-agreement design only; the official run recomputes everything itself

claims.claim: All 8 chains' independently-computed tips / binding facts AGREE with the wave-46 receipted pins: chains_agreed = 8/8, two-reader receipt all_agree = true. Stone chains: computed tip == fleet_receipted_tip AND links match AND bytes sha match. Witness KAT: computed tip == fleet_receipted_tip AND receipt count == 5. Binding artifacts: artifact sha, predictions sha and all three embedded-binding facts equal the fleet's receipted detail. Fixture manifest: all 4 file shas equal their pins.
claims.falsifier: any chain with agree=false, any links/bytes-sha mismatch, or runner exit non-zero on the official run

claims.claim: Negative controls FAIL CLOSED: every injected fault is caught and flips the verdict to disagree — tampered stone chain byte, wrong expect-tip pin on an untampered chain, tampered witness receipt byte, skipped middle witness receipt, tampered artifact bytes, tampered predictions bytes, tampered fixture byte — and the untouched-bytes positive control still agrees 8/8. The instrument's exit code reflects each control (0 on agree-only, non-zero on any disagreement).
claims.falsifier: any negative control that still verifies (undetected tamper), or the positive control disagreeing

claims.claim: The walker identity note 'crab-traps-second-reader' is present in EVERY receipt row of the two-reader receipt (inside each receipt's claim text and in each per-chain entry's walker_note field), with zero identity-less rows.
claims.falsifier: any receipt row or per-chain entry lacking the exact walker identity string

claims.claim: Cross-reader byte agreement: LIVE-fetched bytes are byte-identical (sha256) to the fleet rollout's committed fetched/ bytes for all 5 remote chains (qthe e_q10, qthe e_q6, pong birth-seal, crabtraps 45c artifact+predictions, crabtraps 44a artifact+predictions), and all FIXTURE bytes match their pre-registered bytes-sha256 AND git blob pins.
claims.falsifier: any sha divergence between second-reader-fetched bytes and fleet committed bytes, or any fixture bytes/blob pin mismatch

claims.claim: The two-reader receipt is itself a witness chain under the second reader's INDEPENDENT grammar implementation (exact field set, strict sha256 parent links, GENESIS sentinel, duplicate-id rejection): it self-verifies with ok=true, 8 receipts, and the runner exits 0 iff every chain agrees. Additionally, the second reader's canonicalJSON reproduces the fleet walker's receipted output digests for the three non-chain targets when fed the fleet's walker identity (digest reproduction evidence, not an agreement requirement).
claims.falsifier: receipt chain fails self-verification, runner exit code inconsistent with the agreement table, or digest reproduction failing while facts still agree (honest note, not a hard fail)

exit_contract: runner exit 0 iff every chain tip/binding agrees AND the receipt chain self-verifies; exit 1 otherwise; fail-closed on any fetch/pin/walk error
